title: Drift Wood #14 · the mixtape
logline: Chloe makes Wood a tape. Side A is instructions.

margin.note: The crab. He uses it when it's about her, though the strip never says so.

panels.composition: The newsroom. CHLOE slides a cassette across the desk to WOOD. The case insert is hand-lettered in tiny manic capitals.

balloons.text: Side A is things you should have heard by now. Side B is things you'll pretend you already knew.

image.prompt: a teenage girl sliding a cassette tape with a hand-lettered insert across a desk to a boy in an overcoat, school newsroom

panels.composition: The insert, in her handwriting: a track list, and under it, smaller: 'listen in order. no skipping. — c.'

image.prompt: close-up of a cassette case insert covered in tiny cramped handwritten capitals, a track list and a note at the bottom

panels.composition: Wood, holding the tape like an artifact.

balloons.text: This is a curatorial act. A statement. You've made me a—

image.prompt: a teenage boy holding a cassette tape reverently in both hands while a girl beside him looks unimpressed

panels.composition: Wood's bedroom that night. Headphones. The tape playing. He is not drawing. Out the window, rain.

characters.pose: lying on a bed, headphones on, not drawing

image.prompt: a teenage boy lying on his bed at night with headphones on, a tape deck playing, a closed drawing pad beside him, rain in the window, black and white, quiet
image.notes: The pad is closed. Note it in the drawing.
